title: Cleaning of Marine Trash and Micro Debris in the Sea
what_it_is: Cleaning of Marine Trash and Micro Debris in the Sea

sections.label: Beach litter and cleaning frequency
sections.summary: NEA cleans recreational beaches daily or four times a week, twice daily during monsoon periods, with styrofoam, film and hard plastic fragments most common.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The bulk of our beach litter is marine debris brought in by natural tidal conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: NEA cleans our recreational beaches twice a day during the Northeast and Southwest monsoon periods, when the amount of marine debris increases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: During the rest of the year, the beaches are cleaned daily or four times a week depending on the location.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The most common micro- and macro-debris encountered along our shores are styrofoam, film and hard plastic fragments, with some variation in the volume and distribution of macro-debris due to seasonal monsoons.

sections.label: SFA food inspections and kelong query
sections.summary: SFA regularly inspects food for quality and safety, but the Member is asked to file a Parliamentary Question on kelong and micro-plastics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: SFA will ensure quality and safety of our food regularly and they do inspect on a regular basis.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Specifically, with regard to kelong and micro-plastics, I will have to come back to the Member and I will encourage the Member to file a Parliamentary Question if he is interested in this topic.

sections.label: Regional and global marine litter action
sections.summary: Singapore participates regionally and globally, signs declarations on marine litter, and conducts courses for officials on waste and litter management.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Some of the Members here have joined them and would appreciate the enthusiasm and the commitment these groups have demonstrated.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We do actively participate at the regional as well as the global arenas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We participate, we agree, we sign on to declarations to stop and act on marine litter.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are also actively conducting courses for the officials on this issue about tackling waste and managing litters.
